links.outcome: Pneumonia detection MCC by age subgroup (pediatric vs adult) for zero-shot multimodal LLMs versus CNN
links.effect: Pediatric MCC: GPT-5.2 0.484, Claude Opus 4.5 0.470, Gemini 2.5 Pro 0.272 vs CNN 0.799. Age-related ΔMCC larger for LLMs (+0.220 to +0.466) than CNN (+0.051).
links.quote: Age-related gains were larger for LLMs (ΔMCC +0.220 [95% CI 0.160-0.281] to +0.466 [0.407-0.525]) than for the CNN (ΔMCC +0.051 [0.005-0.098]), driven mainly by specificity increases.

links.outcome: Comparison of zero-shot LLMs against domain-trained CNN baseline on same test sets
links.effect: CNN outperformed all LLMs in pediatrics (MCC 0.799 vs 0.484, 0.470, 0.272) and remained best in adults (MCC 0.850).
links.quote: In adults, all models improved, but the CNN remained best (MCC 0.850, 0.816-0.882).

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating zero-shot multimodal LLMs vs. domain-trained CNNs across pediatric and adult cohorts to assess age-related performance disparities and generalization gaps, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
